exercises.name: Front Raise (Band)

source_english.description: Front Raise (Band) raises resistance band forward to a controlled shoulder-height range without leaning back.
instructions: Stand tall holding the resistance band in front of the thighs with a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the arms forward to about shoulder height without leaning back.
Pause briefly with the shoulders down.
Lower slowly to the starting position.
source_english.safety_note: Use a light load and stop before painful shoulder height.

Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Jump explosively off the ground, extending your hips, knees, and ankles.
While in mid-air, quickly bring your arms forward for balance.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
form_cues: Track the knees with the toes.
Keep the chest and trunk controlled.
source_english.safety_note: Use a depth and load that allow a stable knee and hip path.

source_english.description: Support the body on the rings, lower by bending the elbows, and press back to straight arms.
instructions: Start by hanging from the rings with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
form_cues: Keep wrists stacked over the elbows.
Brace the trunk and keep the shoulder blades controlled.
Use a smooth lower and press.
source_english.safety_note: Use a stable setup and stop before the shoulders or wrists lose controlled alignment.
